question: Does Claude Code 2.1.275 load an isolated namespaced command that uses the documented @${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/... file-reference syntax?
productDecision: No command-body rewrite. Preserve native plugin command bytes.

installedDocumentation.negativeFinding: The installed official command-development guidance does not use @{...} braces for Claude file references.

canonicalAddySource.note: No canonical Addy command contains @{./...} or @{../...}; a converter for that synthetic form has no source acceptance case.

probe.isolation: Temporary plugin and workspace under /tmp/plgnz-claude-native-root-probe, passed only through --plugin-dir; native authentication was read without copying credentials, --no-session-persistence prevented session storage, --strict-mcp-config exposed no MCP servers, project-only settings avoided user/project customization writes, and no real Claude plugin store was mutated.
probe.expansionEvidence: The sentinel exists only in the referenced plugin file. Claude returned it exactly without a Read tool call, showing that @${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/... was expanded while the slash command was prepared, before model dispatch.

limits: The file reference is pre-expanded by Claude's slash-command loader, so no Read tool event appears in the transcript.

An earlier isolated-HOME attempt stopped before dispatch because that temporary home had no authentication; it made zero model calls and is retained at /tmp/plgnz-claude-native-root-probe/transcript.jsonl.

This evidence proves Claude's documented @${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/... form and rejects the unsupported @{${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/...} rewrite; it does not assign source-command-relative meaning to arbitrary bare relative paths.
